## Headers

- [Messenger.h](Messenger.h): One live conversation with another of this user's processes, ready for app code: where a Channel is a byte stream and a manual reader thread, a Messenger is whole messages and main-thread callbacks. (declares `Messenger`, `MessageServer`)
